pages.html:
✎ Mira Hale
  • Home
  • Gallery

  • Commissions

About Mira

Mira Hale is a Bristol-based illustrator known for her whimsical, botanically-inspired artwork that blends traditional gouache painting with digital finishing. Her work has graced book covers, wedding stationery, nursery murals and editorial spreads across the UK and beyond.

Raised in a small Devon village surrounded by hedgerows and wildflowers, Mira has always found inspiration in the natural world. She studied Illustration at the Falmouth School of Art, graduating with first-class honours, before spending several years working as a studio assistant for a greetings card company — an experience that taught her the discipline of deadlines and the joy of making art for everyday life.

Today, Mira works from a converted garden studio, where she paints small-batch originals, takes on select commissions and teaches the occasional weekend watercolour workshop. She believes illustration should feel like a warm hand extended to the viewer: gentle, a little magical, and unmistakably human.

My Journey

  1. 2014

    Graduated from Falmouth School of Art

    Completed a BA (Hons) in Illustration, with a dissertation on botanical symbolism in folk art.

  2. 2016

    First published book cover

    Illustrated the cover for a debut novel, “The Orchard of Quiet Hours,” which went on to win a regional literary prize.

  3. 2019

    Opened the Bristol studio

    Moved into a dedicated garden studio and began accepting private commissions full-time.

  4. 2022

    First solo exhibition

    “Hedgerow Tales” was shown at the Clifton Arts Collective, featuring thirty original gouache paintings.

  5. 2024

    100th commission completed

    Celebrated a milestone of one hundred commissioned pieces for clients across twelve countries.

What I Value

Warmth Over Perfection

I favour a little wobble in a line if it carries more feeling. Art should feel alive, not machine-made.

Nature as Teacher

Every leaf, feather and petal in my work is studied from life. The natural world is my endless sketchbook.

Honest Collaboration

Commissions are a conversation. I listen closely to what a client is hoping to capture before a single mark is made.

Kind Words

“Mira captured our wedding venue so beautifully we cried when we opened the parcel. It now hangs above our fireplace.”

— Eleanor & James Whitfield, Bath

“Working with Mira on our children's book was a joy from start to finish. She brought our story to life with such tenderness.”

— Priya Shah, Fernleaf Press

“The nursery mural exceeded every expectation. My daughter calls it her 'magic forest' and asks to sleep under it every night.”

— Harriet Dunmore, Bristol

“Professional, prompt, and wildly talented. Mira's pet portrait of our old spaniel is now our most treasured possession.”

— Tom Castellan, Edinburgh

Mira Hale Illustration

14 Willowmere Lane, Bristol, BS6 7QJ · hello@mirahaleillustration.com · +44 117 946 0213

© 2024 Mira Hale Illustration. All rights reserved.

pages.title: Commissions — Mira Hale Illustration
pages.html:
✎ Mira Hale
  • Home
  • Gallery
  • About
  • Commissions

Commissions

Commission Types

I offer a range of illustration commissions, from intimate portraits to full editorial spreads. Each piece is hand-drawn and painted digitally, with a whimsical, storybook sensibility.

Portraits

Personal or gift portraits of people, pets, or loved ones, rendered in soft watercolour-inspired digital brushwork.

Children's Books

Full picture-book illustration packages, including character design, spot illustrations, and full-page spreads.

Editorial & Branding

Custom artwork for magazines, zines, packaging, and small-business branding that needs a warm, hand-made touch.

Pricing

Prices below are starting points; final quotes depend on complexity, size, and licensing. All commissions include two rounds of revisions.

Commission pricing by type
Type Starting Price Delivery Time
Single Portrait (digital file) £120 1–2 weeks
Portrait, printed & framed £180 2–3 weeks
Picture Book Page (per spread) £300 3–4 weeks
Editorial Illustration £250 2–3 weeks
Brand Illustration Set (4 pieces) £650 4–5 weeks

How Commissions Work

  1. 1

    Enquiry

    Send a message through the form below describing your idea, preferred size, and timeline. I reply within two business days.

  2. 2

    Quote & Deposit

    I'll send a written quote and timeline. A 50% deposit secures your place in my queue.

  3. 3

    Sketches

    You'll receive two to three rough sketch concepts to choose from, with room for feedback.

  4. 4

    Final Artwork

    Once the sketch is approved, I complete the full-colour piece and deliver high-resolution files or prints.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you accept rush commissions?

Occasionally, for an added 25% rush fee, depending on my current queue. Mention your deadline in the enquiry form and I'll let you know if it's possible.

What file formats do I receive?

Digital commissions are delivered as high-resolution PNG and print-ready PDF files. Physical prints are shipped in protective packaging within the UK and internationally.

Can I use the artwork commercially?

Personal-use licensing is included by default. Commercial licensing (packaging, merchandise, advertising) is available for an additional fee — just ask when you enquire.

What if I don't like the sketch?

That's completely fine. Revisions at the sketch stage are included, and we'll keep refining until the direction feels right before I move to final colour.

Send an Enquiry

Tell me a little about your project and I'll get back to you with availability and a quote.

Mira Hale Illustration

14 Willowmere Lane, Bristol, BS6 7QJ · hello@mirahaleillustration.com · +44 117 946 0213

© 2024 Mira Hale Illustration. All rights reserved.

Commissions

Commission Types

I offer a range of illustration commissions, from intimate portraits to full editorial spreads. Each piece is hand-drawn and painted digitally, with a whimsical, storybook sensibility.

Portraits

Personal or gift portraits of people, pets, or loved ones, rendered in soft watercolour-inspired digital brushwork.

Children's Books

Full picture-book illustration packages, including character design, spot illustrations, and full-page spreads.

Editorial & Branding

Custom artwork for magazines, zines, packaging, and small-business branding that needs a warm, hand-made touch.

Pricing

Prices below are starting points; final quotes depend on complexity, size, and licensing. All commissions include two rounds of revisions.

Commission pricing by type
Type Starting Price Delivery Time
Single Portrait (digital file) £120 1–2 weeks
Portrait, printed & framed £180 2–3 weeks
Picture Book Page (per spread) £300 3–4 weeks
Editorial Illustration £250 2–3 weeks
Brand Illustration Set (4 pieces) £650 4–5 weeks

How Commissions Work

  1. 1

    Enquiry

    Send a message through the form below describing your idea, preferred size, and timeline. I reply within two business days.

  2. 2

    Quote & Deposit

    I'll send a written quote and timeline. A 50% deposit secures your place in my queue.

  3. 3

    Sketches

    You'll receive two to three rough sketch concepts to choose from, with room for feedback.

  4. 4

    Final Artwork

    Once the sketch is approved, I complete the full-colour piece and deliver high-resolution files or prints.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you accept rush commissions?

Occasionally, for an added 25% rush fee, depending on my current queue. Mention your deadline in the enquiry form and I'll let you know if it's possible.

What file formats do I receive?

Digital commissions are delivered as high-resolution PNG and print-ready PDF files. Physical prints are shipped in protective packaging within the UK and internationally.

Can I use the artwork commercially?

Personal-use licensing is included by default. Commercial licensing (packaging, merchandise, advertising) is available for an additional fee — just ask when you enquire.

What if I don't like the sketch?

That's completely fine. Revisions at the sketch stage are included, and we'll keep refining until the direction feels right before I move to final colour.

Send an Enquiry

Tell me a little about your project and I'll get back to you with availability and a quote.
